multisig.note: k-of-n threshold accounts and all-keys MuSig2; add this phone's key and pasted keys from other signers

hw_signer.note: Cosigns by pasting PSBTs with another Winnow or Core; hardware wallets are stated as not yet verified

psbt.note: Shared accounts only: copy or share a request or raw PSBT and paste one back; the everyday wallet signs in-app

watch_only.note: Descriptor-only backup JSON restores watch-only; shared accounts add from a card; no xpub or address entry

passphrase.note: Seed is derived with an empty BIP39 passphrase; no passphrase field when creating, backing up or importing

coin_control.note: Send picks coins automatically, largest first, for the wallet and shared accounts; coin list is read-only

fee_bump.note: RBF Bump fee in Advanced mode for own pending sends with unspent change; none for shared accounts; no CPFP

taproot.note: Receives to BIP86 bc1p addresses by default; shared accounts are Taproot too (script path or MuSig2)

descriptors.note: Shared accounts show a copyable descriptor in Advanced mode; the everyday wallet's is only inside its backup JSON

own_server.note: Manual host:port peers under Advanced mode, tried first; peer must serve compact filters; pool still fills from others

verifies_chain.note: Checks header work, cross-checks filter headers across peers, matches filters locally; verifies fetched blocks

tor.note: No bundled Tor or I2P client; routes peers through SOCKS gateways you run, found on Tailscale or set by hand

seed_standard.note: 12-word BIP39 phrase on BIP86 paths; the app restores only from its backup file, not from the words alone

cloud_backup.note: On by default: AES-GCM backup to the person's private CloudKit database, key in iCloud Keychain; file backup too
